# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED's top pick, at $109 list and about $98 on sale, with $80 listed at Best Buy and $90 at Amazon. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer. The phone pad tilts, it works in landscape for StandBy, and it has a 2-year warranty. [WIRED review and shop links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169).** It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone and has a heavy, glossy base. It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25). [WIRED review and shop link](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best value for 25W: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W).** [Buy at ESR's US store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- It lists at $99.99. With code PARTNER18 it comes to about $82, according to Dealectric, which says it tested the code in ESR's cart on 2026-10-23. Confirm the final price at checkout.
- It has an active cooling fan, and WIRED notes a button to switch the fan off at night. It includes a 50W adapter and folds for travel.
- The plastic build isn't premium, per WIRED.
- Dealectric says 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other iPhones get 20W or less, so check your model. Macworld describes 25W as available on iPhone 16/17 series generally, so the sources differ.
- Disclosure: that link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Other good options**
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99.** It's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand Macworld has tested, with a 45W adapter included. Good as a desk charger that also travels. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **Nimble Podium 3-in-1, about $130–140.** Your devices lie flat, which suits a bedroom, and it supports Qi2 25W. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best left overnight. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Cheapest Qi2 pick: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W).** WIRED lists it at about $40, marked down from $80, on Amazon. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Travel pick: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2, 15W), about $80.** [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**My recommendation:** If you charge overnight, WIRED says 25W makes little difference, so the Belkin is the safest buy. If you have an iPhone 17 or 16 Pro Max and want 25W, the ESR CryoBoost is the cheapest way to get it. I couldn't verify direct product links for the non-ESR models. The WIRED pages above have current shop buttons, and prices change often.
